about.bio: I went independent in April 2026 and have been working as a freelance web engineer. My strength is handling everything end-to-end — from requirements and design to implementation and release — across both frontend and backend. I also help turn vibe-coded apps into sustainable, extensible products.

meta.NAME: Taishi Hamano / 濱野 大志

profile.label: (01) — PROFILE
profile.statement:
Not just building it,
but making it last and get used.
profile.body:
I went independent in April 2026 and work as a freelance web engineer. I can cover frontend and backend alike, and my strength is handling everything end to end — from requirements and design to implementation and release.

Lately I also help businesses adopt AI as a consultant. Until around the end of 2027 I am traveling the world as a nomad, continuing to build wherever I am.

journey.label: (02) — JOURNEY
journey.title: The
journey.intro: Starting from Japan, through Taiwan to North America and Central America. Right now I am in El Salvador, heading down South America toward South Africa — the plan runs until around the end of 2027.

rhythm.title: A day
rhythm.intro: The place changes, but the rhythm of my day does not. Meetings are gathered in morning and evening slots, and the daytime goes to focused work and wandering the city.
rhythm.centerSub: A day in the life of a nomad
